operation.summary: Replace a linked device's permissions on this phone (a portal viewer, hub or satellite), within what its pairing gave it; Superpowers required, as for agent grants; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: capabilities
body.description: Permission ids, a subset of can_be_given; [] removes all but the always-allowed ones

operation.returns: the linked device as in GET plus changed; forbidden beyond can_be_given

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
